LanguageData.yuki.label: Ice Dragon Yuki
LanguageData.yuki.description:
A dragon that was once feared in the eastern countries. Defeated after seven days of battle with Miko, changed from a dragon to a human figure At the same time, some of the abilities seem to have been sealed.
Revenge on humans and Miko gradually faded, and now she is enjoying human culture. It seems to be able to handle personal computers. Miko can't win with power, so she tries to win with IT knowledge Counterattack with physics or witchcraft.
